description: A team of a solo 14-year-old student. Who has always aspired and dreamt of doing something for the space and the world for the greater good.
summary: TerraTrek is a simple, user-friendly interactive website which displays the analogue locations for the Moon and Mars. It showcases pre-existing analogues and newly proposed sites and why they might be a good place for research. Due to its easy-to-use interface, anyone, from a student to a researcher, can understand the need for analogues and which ones work.
details: TerraTrek has a simple purpose. Showcase the analogues for Mars and the Moon, and provide a short summary on why it works. It compiles all the data into a small summary and saves the hassle of gathering information from all across the internet, which can be pretty time-consuming. I used an Asus Vivobook and VS Code to develop my project. TerraTrek has a very easy-to-use interface and a very appealing presence. It is captivating to the eyes while following a simple approach.
